## 👋 Hi, I'm Aylin

I am a **Data Scientist / ML Engineer**, specializing in **Computer Vision**, **Heterogenious (Sensor) Data Fusion**, and **Time Series Aggregation Analytics**. 
My work bridges academic research and industrial implementation, transforming complex multimodal data into actionable insights. 

---

## 🔬 Research & Projects

### Forest Segmentation (M.Sc. Thesis)
*Evaluating Impact of Data Augmentation on LiDAR + RGBI Fusion*
- Achieved **IoU improvement: 70.4% → 75.1%** via multimodal fusion
- Implemented U-Net variants (HRNet-inspired, FusionNet-inspired)
- Extracted structural layers from 3D point cloud data

### Railway Semantic Segmentation (RailSem19)
- Built vegetation segmentation pipeline for digital twin concepts.
- Compared HRNet vs. LangSAM performance with conceptual alert system for severity classification.
